summary: Iteration 7 frontend verification of the ArchiveScene 7-image REEL expansion + exit circle-wipe timing fix. Desktop (1920x800) reel sweep, full-timeline regression sweep, traveler behaviour, reverse scrub, mobile (390x844) sweep, cold-load performance sanity, and cross-scene regressions (statement/transit/contact/back-to-top/estimator/USD-INR) all executed via DOM probes with lenis immediate scrollTo + 1.9s settle after hard reload. Backend pytest 9/9 passed. Zero console/page errors across every run. ONE real defect found: on MOBILE the .ax-dark exit circle-wipe is still positioned at t=17.55 while the mobile resolve beats run 17.4-19.05, so the final 'THE ARCHIVE / IS JUST / BEGINNING.' resolve is completely covered by the black wipe and is never visible on mobile. Desktop equivalent (29.7) is correct.

ui_bugs.issue: Exit circle-wipe fires too early and buries the final resolve. .ax-dark fromTo is positioned at 17.55 (dur 0.9 -> full at 18.45) but the mobile resolve beats are: .ax-beg set 17.4 / rise 17.75-18.45, .ax-arch3 fade 18.05-18.40, .ax-just fade 18.15-18.45, hold to 19.05, hide at 18.75-19.05. Measured: at d=0.94 darkCircle=27.9%, d=0.95 darkCircle=114% while arch3 was only at 0.26 opacity, d=0.96 darkCircle=138.8% with arch3=0.9 -> the resolve is 100% behind opaque black at every point where it is legible. Screenshot at d=0.955 is a fully black frame. Desktop 29.7 is correct; mobile appears to have received the desktop-relative number instead of its own. Suggested position: ~18.8 (after the 18.75 hide) or at minimum 18.45, keeping dur 0.9.

action_items: ArchiveScene.jsx mobile branch: move the .ax-dark exit circle-wipe from position 17.55 to ~18.8 so the mobile 'THE ARCHIVE / IS JUST / BEGINNING.' resolve is visible before the wipe. This is the same class of bug as the desktop t22.3 issue — the mobile number was not shifted with its own beats.
critical_code_review_comments: The mobile exit fromTo has its position argument (17.55) on a separate line from the tween, the exact pattern that caused the original desktop t22.3 miss. Consider co-locating positions or deriving all beat times from a single named constants object (e.g. T.exit) per breakpoint so numeric shifts cannot desync again.

Documented mobile total is 18.85 but the actual timeline duration is 19.05 (last tween = 18.75 + 0.3). Depth->time math based on 18.85 is off by ~1%. Desktop is exact (29.7 + 1.0 = 30.7, matches the 30.7 rail tween). Update the comment/spec or pad the mobile timeline explicitly.

Beat comment blocks above both matchMedia branches still describe the pre-expansion 23.3-unit timeline ('total: 23.3 units', 'BEAT H 14.3-15.55', 'BEAT I 15.5-17.35', 'exit 22.2-23.3'). Misleading for the next editor — refresh them to the 30.7/19.05 numbers.

ArchiveScene.jsx is 455 lines with a 230-line useLayoutEffect; the desktop and mobile timelines are near-duplicate structures (REEL loop, splice, resolve). Extracting buildDesktopTimeline/buildMobileTimeline into separate modules would make future numeric shifts safer.

rca_of_the_issue: The desktop exit-wipe bug was fixed by moving the fromTo to position 29.7, but the mobile branch's wipe was left/set at 17.55. The mobile timeline has its own, shorter beat map whose resolve sequence occupies 17.4-19.05, so 17.55 lands at the very start of the resolve instead of after it — the black circle reaches 140% coverage by t~18.4 while THE ARCHIVE / IS JUST are still fading in. Reproduction: viewport 390x844, hard reload, scroll to pinBase + d*9.8*innerHeight for d in 0.93..0.99 and read getComputedStyle('.ax-dark').clipPath against '.ax-arch3'/'.ax-just' opacity — dark is fully expanded while the type opacities are still ramping. Mitigation: reposition the mobile .ax-dark fromTo to ~18.8 (dur 0.9), i.e. after the 18.75 hide, mirroring how desktop's 29.7 sits after its 29.6 hide.
